title: Made a strategy / city builder about Oxford colleges
author: chemprof1337
selftext:
I've had this idea for a game for about 20 years since I worked at Oxford University for a few years. The game is a strategy city builder where you build a college through 900 years of history, competing with others for discoveries, prestige and sporting success. I was able to make it with Opus 5.5 in just over 3 weeks, about 700 turns. 

It's a historical city builder mixed with a Crusader Kings II style character based strategy. I don't think a game in this genre exists really. It turned into a bit of a love letter to English history, with a lot of historical content. I admit the topic is pretty niche and not everyone's cup of tea - but if you can find some time to play it I'd very much appreciate any comments!

I tried to pay a lot of attention to balancing the game - Claude could run 100s of simulated games with different strategies to see what was OP and what was useless.

One thing I liked about CK2 was that you got a good system set up and balanced, and then something would come along and disrupt it, and you'd have to scramble to fix things as best you could. Claude was good at suggesting ways to get that kind of gameplay in.

OpenArt for the images, Suno for music, ElevenLabs for a few sound effects (minimal). OpenArt MCP was the gamechanger allowing me to quickly iterate game art.

I tried to round it out near to commercial standards with a tutorial, reference pages, period music etc

Let me know what you think - free to play in browser here:  
  
[https://darkacademia.itch.io/dreaming-spires](https://darkacademia.itch.io/dreaming-spires)
